title: DelftX — Pre-University Calculus (free, audit track)
why: The preparation course TU Delft itself recommends for the CST Mathematics test (Brochure 2, 2027-2028). Covers functions, equations, differentiation, integration and analytic geometry at exactly the expected level.
note: Self-paced; pick the modules that match the unit you are on rather than doing it front to back.

title: TU Delft Brochure 2 — Matching & Selection BSc CSE 2027-2028 (syllabus + formula sheet in the appendix)
why: The official description of the CST: two tests (Mathematics 50%, 60 min; Systematic Reasoning & Logical Thinking 50%, 45 min), no calculator, exact answers, the full maths syllabus and the formula sheet you get during the test.
note: The older link in your brief (…/Brochure%202%20-%20Matching%20_%20Selection%20BSc%20CSE.pdf) returned 404 on 24 Oct 2026; this is the current 2027-2028 v2 file linked from the TU Delft selection page.

title: CST preparation lecture 2024 (YouTube)
why: TU Delft lecturers walk through CST-style exercises for both tests — the closest thing to an official worked example set.

title: CST 2024 workshop (with solutions)
why: Exercises with official solutions that accompany the 2024 preparation lecture. Use them as a timed check after the matching units.
note: No URL in the brief. Add it to content/resources.json once you have it.

title: How I prepared for the Mathematics Exam – TU Delft CSE (YouTube)
why: A student's account of what the maths test emphasised and how they planned their preparation.

title: TU/e mathematical practice materials (Wistue)
why: The practice material TU/e itself points to for its Mathematics test. Login instructions are in the Wistue manual linked from the TU/e selection page.

title: Delftse Foundations of Computation — chapter 2 (skip starred sections)
why: The official preparation text for Systematic Reasoning & Logical Thinking (Brochure 2). Propositional logic, Boolean algebra, predicate logic and deduction in the notation the test uses.
note: Free download from the TU Delft Open Textbook repository. The book has exercises but no official answers.

title: Notes for Systematic Reasoning & Logical Thinking (Google Doc)
why: Condensed notes on chapter 2 — useful as a review sheet in the weeks before the test.

title: How to Read Logic (YouTube)
why: Trains the skill of translating dense English into formulas — exactly what L5 practises.

title: How I prepared for the Reasoning and Logic Exam (YouTube)
why: A student's preparation strategy for the SR&LT test.

title: Quizlet — Delft CST logic exam flash cards
why: Quick drill of laws and definitions (De Morgan, contrapositive, quantifier negation).
note: No URL in the brief. Community-made; check cards against the textbook.

title: TU Delft example entrance test (2008)
why: An old official-style test — good for a one-off timed attempt late in Phase 3. Its format predates the CST, so use it for style, not for exact difficulty.

title: UK Bebras Challenge — Elite level past questions
why: Computational-thinking puzzles in the same style as the algorithmic test but easier. Ideal for daily warm-ups in Phase 1.
note: Past challenges are on the challenges page without login. Elite = ages 16–19.

title: How I prepared for the Algor. & Comp. Thinking Exam (YouTube)
why: A student's approach to the algorithmic-thinking part (from the years when the CST still had one). Still relevant for the TU/e Algorithmic Thinking test (40% of the TU/e ranking).

title: Delftprep — CSE 2025 selection guide
why: Third-party overview of the selection procedure and preparation tips.
note: No URL in the brief. Third-party: the 2025 guide predates the 2027-2028 change to a two-test CST.

title: How I Got Into TU Delft BSc CSE (2024 video)
why: Motivation and a realistic picture of the procedure from a recent applicant.

title: How I Got Into TU Delft BSc CSE (second video)
why: A second applicant's perspective on preparation and timing.

title: TU Delft preparation entrance exam 2023 (YouTube playlist)
why: Worked videos from the 2023 preparation material.

title: Community "CST TU Delft GPT"
why: Community chatbot for practice questions. Treat its answers as unverified, and remember AI tools are not allowed during the CST itself.
note: No URL in the brief. Not official; answers are not checked.

title: TU/e Online Study Experience modules
why: TU/e's own taster modules — a feel for the programme and its style of problems.

title: TU Delft — CSE selection procedure page (official)
why: Source for dates, capacity and the links to Brochure 2, the timeline and the 2027-2028 regulation.
note: Extra, not on your list — the official procedure page (link checked 24 Oct 2026).

title: TU/e — CSE selection procedure page (official)
why: Links to the departmental regulations (weights 10/40/40 + VWO 10), the important-dates PDF, Pruefster proctoring rules and Wistue.
note: Extra, not on your list — the official procedure page (link checked 24 Oct 2026).
